title: MCP search for lawyers
summary: Adds an MCP gateway in front of the indexer so lawyers can search their documents from Claude. The legacy nightly sync goes away; the indexer now re-indexes from change events.

source.label: Gerrit chain 6231→6239 plus one local commit (10 changes)

changes.subject: mcp-gateway: scaffold the Connect service and router
mcp-gateway: add auth middleware with token introspection
mcp-gateway: write an audit record per tool call
indexer: consume change events from JetStream
indexer: embed chunks and upsert into pgvector
legacy-sync: delete the nightly sync job

nodes.detail:
New service. Every tool call is authenticated, dispatched and audited.

- runs as 2 replicas behind the auth proxy
- exposes `/mcp` over HTTPS

**Review focus:** the auth middleware and the audit write.
